slots.root: flex flex-col gap-2 border-[color:var(--surfaces-plain-card-edge-rest,var(--edge-surface))] bg-[color:var(--surfaces-plain-card-fill-rest,var(--fill-surface))] border-[length:var(--bw-surface)] rounded-surface p-surface min-h-30 shadow-surface-rest
slots.head: flex items-center justify-between gap-items
slots.label: font-face-label text-label tracking-label-role case-label text-[color:color-mix(in_oklab,var(--text-muted-ink-rest,var(--ink-muted))_var(--level-ink-muted),transparent)]
slots.value: font-face-heading font-heading text-h2 leading-snug tabular-nums tracking-heading text-[color:var(--arena-accent-marks-label-ink)]
slots.delta: self-start inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-marker px-2 py-0.5 bg-transparent border-[length:var(--bw-marker)] font-body text-ctl-sm font-semibold

internal.deltaTone: the delta object's tone (ArenaStatDelta.tone), on the delta slot, which cannot share a name with the card's own tone
